Title: Azure Cosmos DB: General availability in Australia

Body.Content: Azure Cosmos DB now supports provisioning Cosmos DB accounts in the East Australia and Southeast Australia regions, in addition to the existing supported regions: East US, West US, North Europe, West Europe, East Asia, and Southeast Asia. To learn more about the new regions and account limits, you can read the blog announcement: Azure Cosmos DB – G’Day Australia! For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
